title: Latent Information Sharing for Accelerating Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.01126v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a communication-efficient distributed learning paradigm. However, client drift remains one of the most critical challenges, hindering the efficient training of a global model. In this study, we propose a novel latent information sharing scheme that directly mitigates data heterogeneity across clients. Our theoretical and empirical results show that sharing a small amount of hidden-layer activations significantly improves training efficiency while preserving convergence guarantees and data privacy. Furthermore, we compare our method with existing FL approaches designed to address client drift, including FedProx, SCAFFOLD, FedPVR, FedProto, and SplitFed, and demonstrate superior model accuracy under a fixed round budget without incurring excessive communication overhead. translated_title: 用于加速联邦学习的潜在信息共享
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）是一种通信高效的分布式学习范式。然而，客户端漂移仍然是最关键的挑战之一，阻碍了全局模型的高效训练。在本研究中，我们提出了一种新颖的潜在信息共享方案，直接缓解客户端之间的数据异构性问题。我们的理论和实证结果表明，共享少量的隐藏层激活值可以显著提高训练效率，同时保持收敛保证和数据隐私。此外，我们将我们的方法与现有的旨在解决客户端漂移的联邦学习方法（包括FedProx、SCAFFOLD、FedPVR、FedProto和SplitFed）进行了比较，并在固定轮次预算下展示了更优的模型精度，且不会产生过多的通信开销。总的来说，这项工作提出了一种有前景的新型知识聚合方案，并对激活值共享的影响进行了全面分析。
tldr: 该论文提出一种潜在信息共享方案，通过在客户端间共享少量隐藏层激活值直接缓解数据异构性问题，在保证收敛性和数据隐私的前提下显著提升了联邦学习的训练效率和模型精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a latent information sharing scheme that directly mitigates data heterogeneity across clients by sharing a small amount of hidden-layer activations, significantly improving training efficiency and model accuracy while preserving convergence guarantees and data privacy.
